Messaging and chat interfaces package.' and arena_slice 'full-stack-express-sqlite-messaging-chat-kittle-matter-chat' all name the same task and stack; package.json name 'kittle-matter-chat' v1.0.0 agrees with provenance; app_context.md 'Name: Kittle & Rowe matter chat', render gate line 27 and index.html <title> agree with instruction.md's Kittle & Rowe. [task].version absent, which is optional in the staged layout. Stale cross-task identity: the only other-task names in the tree are a comment in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml line 12 citing HireOps/Colderwater as precedent for an individual-mode exception; that is a rationale comment, not task identity metadata. Non-blocking notes: (1) description summarizes walls/timers/holds/transcripts (the brief's 'two things that matter more than anything else') but omits the conversation axes (nested replies, edits/stale-edit refusal, safe formatting, message links, mentions, unread line, live updates) that make up many of the 17 functional criteria; adding a short clause would make the metadata fuller. (2) 'Express' in description/keywords reflects the preinstalled runtime rather than a mandated framework; metadata only, not graded, so no conflict. Counterexample attempt: a judge/metadata consumer reading this toml would not be misled about which product, stack or category the task is; no field contradicts another or the brief. This row is metadata-only, so weak/alternative app considerations do not apply.
